project: The Formula of Becoming - Week 1 Day 4 - Full Cast

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: On Monday, Dr. Brooks closed the classroom door and asked everyone to put away their calculators.

items.speaker: dr-brooks
items.text: Today,

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: she said,

items.speaker: dr-brooks
items.text: I want the answer nobody can compute for you. Why does mathematics matter?

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: The room went quiet in the special way classrooms do when a question becomes personal.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: Students spoke about engineering, medicine, money, teaching, technology, and being the first in their families to pursue a technical degree.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: When Malik's turn came, he folded his hands on the desk.

items.speaker: malik
items.text: My father can repair almost anything,

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: he said.

items.speaker: malik
items.text: Engines, roofs, appliances. But one unexpected bill can undo months of planning. I want to understand risk well enough to help families and businesses prepare without pretending every loss can be prevented.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: The answer came out more honest than he intended. He looked down after finishing.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: Nia did not make a joke.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: When her turn came, she said,

items.speaker: nia
items.text: My aunt runs a neighborhood tutoring program. Every year she has to prove the same thing to different people: that kids are learning, that the program matters, that the money should continue. I want to use math to make important things harder to ignore.

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: After class, they walked down Eliza Moss Hall's broad staircase.

items.speaker: nia
items.text: You want to make risk visible,

items.speaker: narrator
items.text: Nia said.

items.speaker: malik
items.text: You want to make people visible.

items.speaker: nia
items.text: That sounded like the end of a movie trailer.

items.speaker: malik
items.text: I regret saying it.

items.speaker: nia
items.text: Too late. I heard the music.
